layout.scroll: Body overflow:auto plus results overflow-y:auto; header/footer flex:none. Short viewports may require body scrolling to reach acknowledgement.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Native modal above the working surface.

shadows.name: toast
shadows.purpose: Result feedback in a manual top-layer popover.

behavior.dialog: Native showModal; labelled heading/description; select autofocus; Escape, cancel, close and backdrop discard draft; Ctrl/Meta+Enter reuses validation outside IME composition.
behavior.selection: Sheet-scoped case-insensitive Item name/ID search; selected rows use aria-pressed; explicit consequence and acknowledgement before replacing current or candidate.
behavior.identity: Stable delivery ID is separate from source Item/Run/version; only explicit branch mode creates a new delivery Item.
behavior.versions: Approved source becomes current. Pending source remains candidate; exact source decision derives promotion/rework. Prior current survives a rejected candidate.
behavior.guards: Recheck source identity/readiness, current/candidate duplicate source key, target revision snapshot and acknowledgement at submit.
behavior.previews: Real accepted preview URLs only; missing, rejected or failed URLs show 暂无预览.
behavior.state: Page-session memory only; refresh loses associations/new Items/drafts. No automatic Skill invocation.

limitations: No server persistence or authorization added.
Source Skill matching is restricted to current/candidate Item+Run bindings, not history.
Seed aggregate totals exceed the local sample catalog.
No new motion, synthesized previews or shipping raster.
Fresh finish reviewer could not start because of the agent thread limit; ship is a substituted in-thread check.
Degraded regex detector is not a complete computed-style or accessibility audit.

resolved: Rejected candidates without a current final cannot be reused as ready sources.
Dynamic sheet options expose explicit accessible names.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Submit the selected final or candidate association.

components.description: Cancel without saving the association draft.

narrative.overview: 仅固化“关联任务”详情 CTA、交付 Item 选择、版本变更确认和 Toast。沿用 incumbent 的白色工作面、克制橙色、中文友好的 sans 字体和 Phosphor Regular 图标，不建立或替换全局设计系统。
keyCharacteristics: 先选择交付位置，再确认来源产物。
来源身份、稳定交付 ID 与版本结果明确分开。
缺失预览和本地会话边界如实可见。
dos: Do 保持稳定交付 ID、来源 Item／Run 身份和版本记录。
Do 将候选与已通过版本分开，并明确替换后果。
Do 保留真实缺图占位、可见验证和刷新丢失提示。
donts: Don't 把分支产物自动变成新的交付 Item。
Don't 将本地状态描述成服务端持久化、授权或真实 Skill 执行。
Don't 将本地替代收尾检查描述成 fresh 独立评审。
